title: Finch Circle Program Review Thresholds — Return Ratio and Minimum Returns
content:
The Finch Circle Loyalty Program uses two figures, the same at every tier, to decide when a membership is suspended for a program-abuse review.

| Tier | Return ratio above which the membership is suspended for review (percent) | Minimum returns in the trailing 12 months before the ratio is applied |
|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 50 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Silver | 50 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Gold | 50 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 50 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 50 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Icon | 50 | 10 |

## Definitions

- **Return ratio threshold** — returned value as a percent of gross purchase value over the trailing 12 months above which a membership is suspended for review.
- **Minimum returns** — the minimum number of returns in the trailing 12 months before the return ratio is applied.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- With 9 returns in the trailing 12 months, the minimum of 10 is not reached and the ratio is not applied.
- With 12 returns and a ratio of exactly 50 percent, the ratio is not above 50; at 50.5 percent it is.
